elaine: Kicking off a quick thread for Azure marketplace onboarding for the Private SKU. Two blockers: Key Vault BYOK steps and trial refund policy. Need ops/legal alignment today.

raj: Ops - for Azure BYOK we ask customers to create a Key Vault and grant the publisher SPN `get`, `wrapKey`, `unwrapKey` on the key. I'll draft an example PowerShell command.

ben: Legal - we generally allow BYOK but require a limited warranty and a clause that Redwood's access is constrained to provisioning and billing. Refunds: trials are non-refundable but we can offer credit if billing malfunction occurs.

sofia: Product - trial mechanics: GCP/Azure credit-style trials (30 credits) -> maps to entitlements; hosted has 14-day timebox. For Azure marketplace specifically, trial flow often depends on MPN/CSP path; recommend marking the SKU as "Trial: contact sales" if enrolled via CSP.

raj: PowerShell snippet for Key Vault access control (customer run):

```
az keyvault set-policy --name MyVault --object-id <publisher-spn-object-id> --key-permissions wrapKey unwrapKey get
```

raj: Also note: some customers put keys behind RBAC-only Key Vaults (no access policies). In that case we need the publisher assigned a Key Vault role: `Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User`. I'll include both snippets in the ops doc.

ben: Legal asks: add a short clause that BYOK customers are responsible for key rotation and incident notifications if key compromise occurs. We'll add sample liability limits.

sofia: Assets: please upload logo (1024) and hero image to the canonical folder `marketplace/private/azure/` and include a README with 120-char blurb + three bullets. Ops will validate manifest.

elaine: Can someone create the Azure enrollment checklist (MPN, tax, publisher profile, sample invoice)? Raj can you add the Key Vault steps to that checklist?

raj: Yes, I'll add Key Vault steps and the RBAC variant. ETA EOD.

mp-bot: Created ticket MKP-900: `azure-private-byo-checklist` assigned to ops/product/legal. (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MKP-900)

elaine: Recap: Raj -> ops doc + PowerShell/RBAC snippets EOD; Sofia -> update trial wording and prepare README/assets; Ben -> legal clause for BYOK + refund policy draft. Sync 11:00 PT tomorrow. Thanks! :thumbsup:
